test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.5
solution:
The correct answer is **"Game".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• *"Representations to the Sports Minister and Chief Ministers and interventions by the politicians have all become part of the (5)__________*___" we need an appropriate word from the given options :
 
• Let's understand the meaning of all other options :
 
 
• **Jest**: a joke or prank; something said or done to amuse people
 
• **Game** : physical or mental activity or contest that has rules and that people do for pleasure
 
• **Sport**: physical games or activities that you do for exercise or because you enjoy it
 
• **Line**: a long thin mark on the surface of something or on the ground.
 
 
 
• From the four given options, **Game **is the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank as politicians get involved in this for pleasure.
 
• Thus,the correct answer is **option 2.**

**Hence the correct passage will be : ***Not a year passes without a controversy over the national sports awards. The debate that **arises **every year following the announcement of the **awards** often leads to accusations of bias, regionalism, and manipulations. **Representations **to the Sports Minister and Chief Ministers and **interventions **by the politicians have all become part of the **game.***
